name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused exclusively on the state of Nevada. The company's flagship Lapon Canyon Gold Project sits within the Walker Lane shear zone, with an active 2026 drill program targeting resource expansion and deep intrusive-related gold structures. The company also holds the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar properties in Mineral County, Nevada.
